question: Which Georgia companies produce battery materials such as anodes, cathodes, electrolytes, or copper foil, and what tier are they classified as?
ground_truth:
There are 4 Georgia companies producing battery materials such as anodes, cathodes, electrolytes, or copper foil. 
Duckyang [Tier 2/3] | Produce: High-quality electrodeposited (ED) copper foil for electric vehicles
F&P Georgia Manufacturing [Tier 1/2] | Produce: Lithium-ion battery recycler and raw materials provider
Hollingsworth & Vose Co. [Tier 1/2] | Produce: Lithium-ion battery materials
IMMI [Tier 1/2]  | Produce: Battery electrolyte
answer:
Based on the provided knowledge base, the following companies in Georgia produce battery materials such as anodes, cathodes, electrolytes, or copper foil:

1. f&p georgia manufacturing (Tier 1/2) - Lithium-ion battery recycler and raw materials provider
2. hollingsworth & vose co. (Tier 1/2) - Lithium-ion battery materials
3. duckyang (Tier 2/3) - High-quality electrodeposited (ED) copper foil for electric vehicles

These companies are classified as Tier 1/2 or Tier 2/3, indicating their level of involvement in the automotive supply chain.
